Why Qostara

The estimating partner that treats accuracy as the product

We take fewer jobs than the big outsourcing shops — so every takeoff can survive a peer review and a superintendent's scrutiny.

  • Highly Accurate Estimates

    Dual review on every takeoff. Average variance under two percent against awarded jobs.

  • Fast Turnaround

    Most commercial packages return in 3–5 business days. Rush windows available.

  • Certified Estimators

    AACE and ASPE-credentialed leads on every account, not just the sales call.

  • Latest Pricing Database

    Regional cost libraries refreshed weekly across labour, materials, and equipment.

  • Dedicated Support

    One named estimator for your account. Same person from kickoff through award.

  • Cost Saving Strategies

    Value-engineering options flagged before you bid, not after you lose the job.

How it works

Six steps from drawings to a sealed bid

A clear process, a named estimator, and a deliverable your supers can actually use on site.

  1. 01

    Submit Drawings

    Upload plans, specs, and addenda. PDF, DWG, and Revit are all welcome.

  2. 02

    Project Review

    A senior estimator scopes the set, flags missing sheets, and confirms the bid date.

  3. 03

    Detailed Quantity Takeoff

    Every trade is measured layer by layer with colour-coded source references.

  4. 04

    Pricing Analysis

    Current regional rates, subcontractor quotes, and productivity factors are applied.

  5. 05

    Final Estimate

    You receive a CSI-formatted cost report, Excel export, and mark-up PDFs.

  6. 06

    Delivery & Support

    We walk the numbers with your team and revise for addenda until the bid is sealed.

Trades we cover

Every trade on the drawing set — measured and priced

Specialty estimators for concrete, steel, MEP, finishes, and site work. No generalists guessing at your scope.

  • ConcreteFormwork, rebar, cast-in-place, and precast — counted by pour and by member.
  • ElectricalDevices, feeders, fixtures, and gear — from rough-in through final trim.
  • MechanicalPiping, equipment, and hydronics with complete accessory schedules.
  • SteelStructural and misc. metals with connection details and shop-drawing checks.
  • DrywallPartitions, shaft walls, ceilings, and specialty assemblies by linear foot.
  • PaintingInterior and exterior coatings with substrate prep and mil thickness.
  • RoofingMembrane, metal, and steep-slope systems including flashings and insulation.
  • MasonryCMU, brick, stone, and veneer with reinforcement and accessory counts.
  • FlooringVCT, LVT, tile, carpet, and specialty floors with underlayment allowances.
  • HVACDuctwork, equipment, controls, and insulation with airflow verification.
  • PlumbingDomestic water, DWV, fixtures, and specialties with fixture-unit checks.
  • LandscapingHardscape, planting, irrigation, and site furnishings for the civil set.
